title: ADB-JSP
about: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU) recommends graduate applicants for the ADB Japan Scholarship Program (ADB-JSP). For September 2027 enrolment, the ADB Scholarship 2 application deadline is 8 January 2027, with results on 10 March 2027. Applicants apply to APU first.
requirements: Applicants first apply to an APU graduate programme; APU selects eligible candidates to recommend to the ADB-JSP
card_alt: Card for the ADB-JSP scholarship at Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU), Beppu, Japan; deadline 8 Jan 2027. The photo shows Tokyo Tower in Tokyo, Japan, not Beppu.
